caption:
At a Marathi wedding the antarpat drops on one word. Saavdhan. And every guest looks up at once.

If everyone is going to look up, give them something at the base of the neck: the Baguette Tennis Necklace in Ruby, ₹2,300, 36cm. The season's ruby set is on the last frame, with the bracelet at ₹1,699 and the huggies at ₹1,199.

Take 2 pieces for 10% off or 3 for 20% off. Your bag applies the code, BUY2 or BUY3, by itself.

Today's mangal: Marathi, मंगळ, where the season began. Thank you for reading every script.

[ baguette tennis necklace · 18k gold tone plated · saavdhan ]
first_comment: Shubh mangal to everyone with a wedding this season. Free insured shipping. Cash on delivery available. #NairaFlore #ShaadiSeason #MarathiWedding #WeddingGuest #TennisNecklace
alt_text: Cover of a short video on a deep plum ground: a dark red silk cloth with a gold zari border and a gold fringe hangs from a gold cord on two brass clips, a small steel key hanging from the upper right clip. On the cloth in cream: Shubh Mangal. Saavdhan., and in gold the same words in Marathi script. Below the cloth lies a real necklace of ruby-red rectangular stones in gold-tone claws, coiled once, its strand running out of the frame. In the video the cloth also carries the line: the cloth drops, everyone looks up. Yellow rice falls, the clips open, the cloth drops and reveals a ruby-red baguette necklace worn at the base of the neck with the words: everyone looked up. Then the ruby necklace, bracelet and huggies appear together with their names and prices: 2,300, 1,699 and 1,199 rupees, 18K gold tone plated with ruby-red cubic zirconia, also in crystal and green, above the NAIRA and MANGAL seal with the Marathi word मंगळ and a small steel key.
posting_notes: Cover: since grid pass r3 the cover shows the Ruby Baguette Tennis Necklace (the caption's hero) under the cloth, not the bracelet (which repeated P1 s1's cut-out and stood beside P11's Crystal bracelet in row 1). Post cover.jpg with the Ruby build, cover-crystal.jpg (the Crystal necklace) with the Crystal build.
Upload cover.jpg as the custom cover; keep 'also share to feed' on. The grid shows cover-grid.jpg (y 240-1680).

reel.mp4 carries a near-silent guide track: a soft cloth whoosh as the antarpat falls (3.05-3.95 s) and one small chime as the set arrives (8.10 s), both peaking at -24 dBFS, silence elsewhere. Add the instrumental shehnai from Instagram's library at posting (no lyrics), cut so a beat lands on the drop at 3.05 s, and keep the original audio low.

Stock gate, 21 Nov and again on the morning of 22 Nov: re-read Shopify for the three Ruby variants (25 Oct: necklace Ruby 20, bracelet Ruby 12, huggies Ruby 12; prices 2,300 / 1,699 / 1,199). If any Ruby variant is at 5 or fewer, post the Crystal build (sources.stock_swap) and change the caption to the Crystal set.
